about.hero.title: About us
about.intro.before: With many years of experience in the food industry,
about.intro.after: is a company dedicated to creating quality frozen products that meet the needs of today's consumer.
about.intro.p2: Our story began with a desire to create practical, tasty products that make everyday life easier. Over the years, through continuous development, investment, and dedicated work, we built our offer and earned the trust of consumers and business partners.
about.intro.p3: Today we continue to grow with the same commitment to quality, and with our sights set on new opportunities, modern trends, and the future of the food industry.
about.story.title: Our story
about.story.p1: Our development is built on constantly listening to the market and understanding the needs of the people who choose our products.
about.story.p2: We believe a successful product is the result of a good idea, quality raw materials, modern technology, and a carefully controlled process. That is why we continually work to improve our production and develop new products that bring practicality and quality into everyday life.
about.story.p3: Our range covers a variety of frozen products, created for different tastes, needs, and ways of preparing food.
about.story.p4: From puff pastry products and doughs to pizzas, baked goods, and breaded products, we have built a portfolio that keeps developing in line with the needs of the modern market.
about.quality.title: Quality in every step
about.quality.p1: For us, quality is not only a feature of the finished product. It is a process that begins long before the product reaches the consumer.
about.quality.p2: We carefully follow every stage of production, from the selection and control of raw materials, through the production process, to storage and transport.
about.quality.systems.before: Our work is supported by the
about.quality.systems.after: , so that we can systematically identify and control potential risks and ensure stable product quality and safety.
about.quality.p4: Control continues after production. With proper storage conditions and controlled distribution, we make sure the products keep their quality from our production facilities to the end consumer.
about.innovation.title: Innovation that follows needs
about.innovation.p1: The food industry is constantly changing, and with it, the needs of consumers.
about.innovation.p2: That is why innovation is an important part of our development.
about.innovation.p3: We follow new trends, analyse market needs, and continually look for ways to improve our portfolio. We develop new products and improve existing ones, so we can offer an even wider choice and a better experience.
about.innovation.p4: Our goal is simple: to create products that are practical to prepare, excellent in taste, and suited to a dynamic way of life.
about.moments.title: Products for every moment
about.moments.p1: Modern life calls for food that is high quality, tasty, and practical.
about.moments.p2: That is why our products are created for different moments and needs. Whether it is a quick meal at home, preparing a pizza, a bake for the whole family, or a practical solution for a professional kitchen, our offer is made to make everyday food preparation simpler.
about.moments.p3: The variety of our portfolio lets us keep answering different consumer expectations and leave room for new products and ideas.
about.horeca.title: Solutions for HoReCa
about.horeca.p1: Professional kitchens have specific needs. That is why we develop products that give professionals greater practicality, consistency, and efficiency in their daily work.
about.horeca.p2: Our HoReCa offer is intended for restaurants, hotels, bakers, hospitality venues, and professional kitchens/catering that need reliable products and a stable result.
about.horeca.p3: With a varied range and a professional approach, we want to be a dependable partner to those who create quality food every day.
about.people.title: The people behind the products
about.people.p1: Behind every product is a team of people who put their knowledge, experience, and dedication into what they do.
about.people.p2: We believe the company's development starts with the development of people. That is why we encourage teamwork, responsibility, professionalism, and continuous improvement.
about.people.p3: We create an environment where experience is shared, new ideas are encouraged, and every team member can contribute to shared success.
about.responsibility.title: Responsibility toward the future
about.responsibility.p1: Our responsibility does not end with creating a quality product.
about.responsibility.p2: As a company in the food industry, we are committed to responsible conduct toward our consumers, employees, partners, and the environment.
about.responsibility.p3: We continually work to improve production processes, use resources more efficiently, and manage waste responsibly. At the same time, we invest in knowledge, technology, and development in order to create long-term value.
about.vision.title: Our vision
about.vision.p1: Our vision is to keep growing as a modern, trusted producer of frozen food, recognised for the quality, innovation, and taste of our products.
about.vision.p2: We want to build a brand that recognises the needs of today's consumer, forms long-term partnerships, and keeps moving forward.
about.vision.p3: For us, every new product is a new opportunity. Every improved process is a step forward. And every satisfied consumer is confirmation that we are heading in the right direction.
about.vision.beat.product: Every new product is a new opportunity.
about.vision.beat.process: Every improved process is a step forward.
about.vision.beat.consumer: Every satisfied consumer is confirmation that we are heading in the right direction.
about.close.title: Trio 95
about.close.text: We create products for the modern way of life, with a commitment to quality and a view toward the future.

horeca.hero.title: HoReCa
horeca.hero.subtitle: Your kitchen. Our solutions.
horeca.intro.lead: Quality products, practicality, and a reliable result for the professional kitchen.
horeca.intro.p1: In the HoReCa industry, time, consistency, and quality are especially important. That is why we created an offer that follows the real needs of restaurants, hotels, bakeries, and professional kitchens.
horeca.intro.p2: With Trio 95 you get products that are practical to prepare and made to deliver stable quality with every preparation.
horeca.range.title: Our HoReCa offer
horeca.range.subtitle: Our range is created for professionals who want quality, practicality, and a reliable result in everyday work.
horeca.range.puff.title: Puff pastry products
horeca.range.puff.desc: Crisp, flavourful, and practical solutions for breakfast, a snack, or as part of the offer of every professional venue.
horeca.range.puff.desc2: Products made for easy preparation and a consistent result, from the first portion to the last.
horeca.range.dough.title: Pizzas
horeca.range.dough.desc: A practical solution for professional kitchens/catering that want to offer quality pizza with simple preparation and a consistent result.
horeca.range.dough.desc2: Our products are made to fit the pace of professional work and the different needs of hospitality venues.
horeca.range.fry.title: Breaded products
horeca.range.fry.desc: A varied selection of practical products for fast and simple preparation.
horeca.range.fry.desc2: An excellent solution for restaurants, hospitality venues, and professional kitchens/catering that need products with stable quality and easy preparation.
horeca.benefits.title: Made for professionals
horeca.benefits.practicality.title: Practicality
horeca.benefits.practicality.desc: Time is one of the most important resources in a professional kitchen. Our products are made for simple and efficient preparation.
horeca.benefits.consistency.title: Consistent quality
horeca.benefits.consistency.desc: A stable result matters for every professional venue. Our products are developed with a focus on quality you can expect with every preparation.
horeca.benefits.variety.title: Variety
horeca.benefits.variety.desc: A varied range makes it easy to complement different menus and offers, according to the needs of each venue.
horeca.benefits.safety.title: Safety and control
horeca.benefits.safety.desc: Food quality and safety are part of every step in our production process. Our work is supported by the HACCP system and the ISO 22000:2005 food safety management system.
horeca.partner.title: More than a product
horeca.partner.subtitle: A partner for your kitchen
horeca.partner.p1: We know a professional kitchen does not ask only for a good product.
horeca.partner.p2: What it needs is reliability, practicality, and consistency in everyday work.
horeca.partner.p3: That is why Trio 95 builds long-term partnerships with professionals who want to offer quality food and an excellent experience for their guests.
horeca.partner.p4: Our goal is to help you work more efficiently and create quality products you can trust.
horeca.cta.title: Together we create more
horeca.cta.p1: Whether you are a restaurant, hotel, bakery, coffee bar, or another hospitality venue, our HoReCa offer is made to match the pace of a professional kitchen.
horeca.cta.p2: Discover Trio 95 products and find the solutions that best fit your business.

products.p01.name: Puff pastries with cheese
products.p01.ingredients:
Dough ingredients:
Wheat flour (T-400), water, puff-pastry margarine (sunflower oil 80%, water, emulsifiers: mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids and sunflower lecithin, salt (0,5%), acidity regulator (lactic and citric acid), preservative potassium sorbate, flavouring, colour beta-carotene); sugar, salt

Filling ingredients (30%):
White cheese (white cow’s cheese made from pasteurised cow’s milk with a fat content in dry matter of min. 45%, water 50% and salt 3,5%), water, cheese filling (modified potato starch, palm oil, skimmed milk powder, milk proteins, salt, corn starch, powdered seasoning (fresh cheese), melting salts (sodium phosphate, sodium citrate, polyphosphate), acidity regulator citric acid, egg powder, glucose syrup, hydrolysed vegetable proteins, yeast powder, lactic acid, calcium lactate, stabiliser – guar gum, seasoning) seasoning-dill.
products.p01.preparation: Remove the foil and bake on a baking tray from frozen in a preheated oven at 220 °C for 20 minutes. For a better taste, if desired, brush the pastries with egg before baking and sprinkle with sesame or a similar seasoning of your choice.
